subject: Simplified Rattle installation instructions: Linux, Macintosh, Windows

messages.subject: Simplified Rattle installation instructions: Linux, Macintosh, Windows
parts:
With the imminent release of the Rattle book (http://www.amazon.com/Data-Mining-Rattle-Excavating-Knowledge/dp/1441998896) there is some good news regarding the installation of Rattle on MS/Windows (or more precisely with the installation of RGtk2 on Windows).

With the release of RGtk2 2.20.17 overnight this hurdle appears to have been fixed. RGtk2 is now able to successfully install GTK+ on machines where it could not previously do so.

For all tested platforms (now including Mac OS X), the basic installation instructions are now:

Install R 2.13.1
Startup R
> install.packages("rattle")
> rattle()

This will just work if the GTK+ libraries are installed. On GNU/Linux, they generally are installed. On Mac OS X, you will be prompted to install them if they are not already installed. On Windows you'll see a message about a missing library and then be prompted to install them if they are not already installed.

Details are available from http://rattle.togaware.com.

Regards,
Graham
